metadata.title: Retail gaze, CCTV twins, and ultrasonic cross-device tracking (uXDT)
metadata.frame: UwU Underground 22 Sep 2026 QT of Auki/CactusXR treated as lead. Independently: Cactus maps existing CCTV + phone digital twin to shelf-attention heatmaps (pose/head, not pupil). uXDT (SilverPush/Shopkick/LISNR, PETS 2017, FTC 2016) is a separate 18-22 kHz phone-mic stitch. Same rhyme (body into merchandising data, no extra hardware); not the same product. Overlay.

edges.notes: Cactus is Auki's retail spatial-AI copilot (phone twin, QR portals, cameras/robots). Pitch: existing CCTV + phone map; up to $500/month/location (Auki 18 Sep 2026 recap) (fact of product).

Existing store CCTV + phone-built digital twin -> pose/head-direction heatmaps tied to SKUs. Not pupil tracking; not a named-shopper join in the public demo. Company product, not a third-party accuracy audit (fact of the pitch).

uXDT SDK: inaudible ~18-22 kHz beacons in ads; app mic reports them. PETS 2017 reverse-engineered History GK (phone number, IMEI, Android ID, Google account). April 2015 claimed >18M devices (fact of the paper/SDK; current covert census not done).
In-store ultrasonic beacons to confirm a walk-in and award points. PETS 2017 heard beacons in 4 of 35 stores in two EU cities; app must be open (fact).

Radius ultrasonic SDK still sold for proximity, ticketing, payments, dynamic ad serving. Vendor: not covert tracking. Capability class is the same 18-22 kHz phone-mic channel (fact of product; intent = their claim).

Mar 2016 FTC warning letters to app developers embedding SilverPush code that could listen for TV-ad ultrasonic beacons via the microphone. Google Play later required disclosure. SilverPush said it stopped inaudible-frequency smartphone ad detection (fact of the letters; 2026 census of remaining covert SDKs not done here).
